name: manifesturl
title: ManifestURL
description: The URL to the app manifest.

payloadkeys.title: The manifest items
payloadkeys.content: An array of dictionaries representing what the manifest installs.

subkeys.title: An asset
subkeys.content: An array of dictionaries that describe an item to install.

subkeys.title: The asset kind
subkeys.content: The kind of manifest item to install. Use `software-package` for apps and macOS packages.

subkeys.title: MD5 hash
subkeys.content: The MD5 hash value the device uses when verifying the hash of the manifest item data. When this key is present, the device ignores the `md5-size` and `md5s` keys.

subkeys.title: MD5 chunk size
subkeys.content: The data chunk size the device uses when verifying the hash of the manifest item data. The device requires this key when the `md5s` key is present.

subkeys.title: MD5 hashes
subkeys.content: An array of strings representing a set of MD5 hash values. The device uses these values to verify the integrity of the downloaded manifest item data. The device requires this key when the `md5-size` key is present.

subkeys.title: SHA256 hash
subkeys.content: The SHA-256 hash value the device uses when verifying the hash of the manifest item data. When this key is present, the device ignores the `sha256-size` and `sha256` keys.

subkeys.title: SHA256 chunk size
subkeys.content: The data chunk size the device uses when verifying the hash of the manifest item data. The device requires this key when the `sha256s` key is present.

subkeys.title: If there are multiple SHA256 hashes provide a chunk size
subkeys.content: An array of strings representing a set of SHA-256 hash values. The device uses these values to verify the integrity of the downloaded manifest item data. The device requires this key when the `sha256-size` key is present.

subkeys.title: The asset URL
subkeys.content: The URL that hosts the manifest item data. The URL needs to start with `https://`.

subkeys.title: Application metadata
subkeys.content: The metadata for an application or package manifest item.

subkeys.title: Bundle identifier
subkeys.content: The bundle identifier of the app or package manifest item.

subkeys.title: The bundle version
subkeys.content: The bundle version of the app or package manifest item.

subkeys.title: The kind
subkeys.content: The type of manifest item. For an app or package, this needs to be `software`.

subkeys.title: The application subtitle
subkeys.content: The name of the app or package developer.

subkeys.title: The title
subkeys.content: The title of the app or package being installed.
